topic.title: What is a Support Level in Trading?

research.summary: A support level is a price area where buying interest may be strong enough to slow or stop a decline. Support is not a guaranteed floor, and price can move below the area.
key_points: Support is better understood as a price area rather than an exact guaranteed price.
Traders often identify support from previous price areas where buying interest appeared.
A support area can fail and price can move below it.
Technical analysis helps interpret market data but does not guarantee future price movement.

script.hook: Support level kya hota hai? Chalo ise simple example se samajhte hain.
script.body: Support ek price area hota hai jahan past mein buying interest dekhne ko mila ho sakta hai. Important point ye hai ki support exact floor nahi hota. Price support ke neeche bhi ja sakta hai. Isliye support ko prediction ya guarantee nahi samajhna chahiye.
